purpose: Stable channel-profile links for social launch traffic. Content-specific links remain available only for surfaces where external links are actually clickable.

links.note: YouTube Shorts descriptions and comments do not provide a clickable external URL, so use the channel-profile link rather than relying on a raw URL in the Short description.

rules: Do not paste a content-specific tracked URL into a caption and assume it is clickable.
Use the stable channel profile link for the main bio/profile CTA.
Use content-specific tracked links only on a verified clickable surface.
Do not rotate the channel-profile URL per post; that would misattribute older post traffic to the newest content.
Measure post-level performance with native platform analytics and site-level acquisition by channel.
